# `rulemaking_lifecycles`

**Rulemaking lifecycles**

One row per docketed proceeding (owner decisions 54-56c): its earliest proposal, the earliest the Register dates, else its upload-dated one (decision 54d), the earliest final strictly after it, or what else its events make (`kind`), with survival columns (`outcome`, `duration_days`, `censor_date`) for time-to-final estimates, Unified Agenda status and routine-family strata. A docket-less proceeding is one Register document that cannot pair and is left out. Keyed `proceeding_id`; joins `proceedings` on it and is joined by `lifecycle_events`. Built by `build_lifecycles`; dates are DATE, counts INTEGER and flags BOOLEAN. Replaces the documents-based rollup withdrawn on 2026-09-23.

**Coverage.** Derived, and bounded by its inputs: every docketed proceeding, paired from its cleaned `lifecycle_events` and censored at the day its inputs end. *(measured 2026-09-28)*

**Data quality.** A Regulations.gov document that states no Register number in `fr_doc_num`, or whose stated number resolves to no Register row, is dated by its upload, which for a legacy document can be years after the rule: on snapshot_9b2c770e's inputs 262 lifecycles anchor on such a document, 74 of them upload pairs outside survival (docs/ontology.md). A proposal typed only by Regulations.gov (`lifecycle_events.source = 'regulations_gov'`, an unnumbered upload) can be a petition for rulemaking, a state program submission or an information-collection notice the Register files under another type: on snapshot_62318069's inputs 515 survival lifecycles since 2015 anchor on one (352 open); a Register number its title names is not read as its identity. Where the proceeding also holds the Register's proposal, the Register's anchors (54d); an upload keeps its anchor when a final falls between the two or the Register's is a comment-period extension or correction, so an earlier proposal whose Register copy is missing may still anchor on its later re-proposal (FDA's 1978 OTC-monograph dockets re-proposed in the 1990s). A final that finalizes another docket's proposal is paired in its own proceeding only and the proposal stays `open`: a RIN never groups dockets (56a), and the Register's docket labels are often an agency's own (2026-15833 names 'CMS-1849-F and CMS-0062-F' and no RIN). A Register proposal naming several dockets anchors one lifecycle per docket (502 proposals behind 2,358 of 35,327 survival rows on snapshot_62318069's inputs; EPA 20%). A posting Regulations.gov flags withdrawn (`documents.withdrawn`) anchors nothing: it was misfiled, duplicated, moved or replaced, and the Register publishes an agency's withdrawal of a rule as a document of its own.
For `routine_family` `pesticide_tolerance` the proposal is usually EPA's notice that it received a pesticide petition (FFDCA 408(d)(3)), typed Proposed Rule, not a proposal of rule text: 443 of the 459 EPA tolerance lifecycles proposed since 2020 on snapshot_448e6d9a's inputs. Time to final then runs from the receipt notice, and `proposal_form` does not tell the two apart.
FDA's notices that it filed a food or color additive petition ("Filing of Food Additive Petition", "… Color Additive Petition") are the same case with no stratum: the Register types them Proposed Rule (its `action`, "Notification of petition.", is not carried by `federal_register`), `routine_family` is NULL, and on snapshot_55d396ee's inputs 64 of the 199 FDA lifecycles proposed since 2018, and 130 of the 831 in the published FDA cell, anchor on one. Match the proposal's Register title (`filing of … petition`) to set them apart. A count of lifecycles counts docketed proceedings, not rulemakings: FNA's three open lifecycles on that snapshot are one RIN, 0584-AF22, in dockets FNA-2026-0034, -0166 and -0201; count distinct `proceedings.rin` for rulemakings.

- **Parquet file:** `rulemaking_lifecycles.parquet`, in the snapshot that `materialized/rulemaking/latest.json` names
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `proceeding_id` | `VARCHAR` | The docketed proceeding the lifecycle reads; joins `proceedings.proceeding_id`. |
| `agency_code` | `VARCHAR` | The proceeding's agency code. |
| `kind` | `VARCHAR` | What its events make: `finalized` (a final strictly after the proposal), `companion` (a Register-dated final on the proposal's Register day, 54b; no survival outcome), `upload_pair` (an upload-dated proposal and a final that day, 54c; no survival outcome), `withdrawn` (a Register or Agenda withdrawal on or after the proposal, no later final), `open` (censored at `censor_date`), `final_without_observed_proposal` or `no_anchor`. |
| `proposal_date` | `DATE` | Day of the earliest proposed event; NULL without a proposal. |
| `proposal_document_id` | `VARCHAR` | The proposal's document: a dated Register record id (`number@YYYY-MM-DD`) when the Register dates a proposal of the proceeding, else a Regulations.gov document id (decision 54d). |
| `proposal_form` | `VARCHAR` | The proposal's form from its title: `proposed`, `advance_proposed`, `comment_period` or `correction`. |
| `final_date` | `DATE` | Day of the final the lifecycle pairs or anchors on; NULL without one. |
| `final_document_id` | `VARCHAR` | The final's document, spelled as `proposal_document_id` is. |
| `final_form` | `VARCHAR` | The final's form from its title: `final`, `interim_final`, `direct_final` or `correction`. |
| `finals_before_proposal` | `INTEGER` | Finals dated before the proposal, counted and never paired; NULL without a proposal. |
| `withdrawal_date` | `DATE` | Day of the withdrawal that makes it `withdrawn`; NULL otherwise. |
| `withdrawal_document_id` | `VARCHAR` | The withdrawal: a dated Register record id, or the agenda item id (`urn:rkaf:us:rin:<rin>`) of an Agenda withdrawal. |
| `outcome` | `VARCHAR` | Its survival outcome: `final`, `withdrawn` (a competing outcome) or `censored`; NULL for a kind outside survival. |
| `duration_days` | `INTEGER` | Days from the proposal to the final, the withdrawal or `censor_date`; NULL without an outcome. |
| `censor_date` | `DATE` | The generation's last event day, capped at the run's day, where open lifecycles are censored; one date in every row. |
| `open_signal` | `VARCHAR` | What the latest Unified Agenda entry of its specific RINs says (`agenda_completed_final`, `agenda_completed_withdrawn`, `agenda_completed_other`, `agenda_long_term`, `agenda_active`, `agenda_dropped_off`), else `not_on_agenda` or `no_specific_rin`. |
| `routine_family` | `VARCHAR` | The routine family the proposal's own title names (the final's without a proposal; the proceeding's with no anchor), read at time zero so the stratum never depends on the outcome (decision 55a): `airworthiness_directive`, `airspace`, `state_air_plan`, `pesticide_tolerance` (pesticide-petition receipts included), `coast_guard_local`; NULL otherwise. |
| `agenda_priority` | `VARCHAR` | That Agenda entry's `priority_category` (e.g. `Economically Significant`); NULL without one. |
| `agenda_major` | `VARCHAR` | That Agenda entry's `major` (`Yes`, `No` or `Undetermined`); NULL without one. |
| `specific_rins` | `VARCHAR[]` | Native list of the RINs the proceeding's docket-side evidence alone holds. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct. |
| `pre_2008_coverage` | `BOOLEAN` | Whether it is anchored before 2008, when Regulations.gov coverage is thin; NULL without an anchor, or for an upload pair from 2008 on. |
